dtc_applicability.condition: MIL and code stored in PCM, hybrid vehicle, TSB criteria
diagnostic_steps: Confirm 2020 Explorer or Police Interceptor Utility hybrid powertrain
Read PCM fault codes and match source list
Follow Ford TSB 20-2345 BECM reprogram procedure using Ford diagnostic tools
After programming inspect low-temperature coolant degas bottle; diagnose if below minimum per WSM 303-03
Recheck MIL and DTCs; escalate unresolved issues via WSM

dtc_applicability.engine: Hybrid Electric Vehicle / HEV
dtc_applicability.condition: MIL and code stored in BECM, bulletin criteria met
diagnostic_steps: Confirm 2020 Escape HEV and vehicle build on/before 10-Jun-2020
Read BECM MIL DTCs; identify whether one or more TSB codes are present
Inspect coolant degas reservoir level against vehicle-specific safe range per WSM 303-03C
If coolant is below range, stop TSB path and diagnose coolant loss instead
If within criteria, follow Ford TSB software update procedure for PCM and BECM and recheck DTCs

escape: Confirm 2020 Escape HEV and vehicle build on/before 10-Jun-2020
Read BECM MIL DTCs; identify whether one or more TSB codes are present
Inspect coolant degas reservoir level against vehicle-specific safe range per WSM 303-03C
If coolant is below range, stop TSB path and diagnose coolant loss instead
If within criteria, follow Ford TSB software update procedure for PCM and BECM and recheck DTCs
explorer: Confirm 2020 Explorer or Police Interceptor Utility hybrid powertrain
Read PCM fault codes and match source list
Follow Ford TSB 20-2345 BECM reprogram procedure using Ford diagnostic tools
After programming inspect low-temperature coolant degas bottle; diagnose if below minimum per WSM 303-03
Recheck MIL and DTCs; escalate unresolved issues via WSM
